tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Ground of every page and video frame: the forest floor by day (linen) and by night.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Author leaves, panels, tooltips and anything lifted off the ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, graph grid and timeline rings. Decorative only: never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Bark. Primary text and the logo ink, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, metadata, captions and secondary text, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Brand colour and primary action; the ecosophy branch. As text, on paper and paper-raised. Also the focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset).

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a moss fill (primary button label, active filter).

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind moss text: selected rows, the active view tab.

tokens.name: humus
tokens.usage: Roots layer: precursors (Quesnay, the physiocrats, Thoreau, Reclus, Kropotkin…). As text, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: humus-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Roots view and of precursor cards.

tokens.name: mycelium
tokens.usage: Influence links between authors across branches (the Mycelium view). As text or 1–1.5px threads on paper.

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: Fill that marks SIMULATED content: agent statements, persona runs. Always with the word Simulated; ink text on it.

tokens.name: lichen-ink
tokens.usage: Lichen as text or a dashed 1.5px border on paper (the Simulated outline).

tokens.name: on-lichen
tokens.usage: Text on a lichen fill (the Simulated label).

tokens.name: branch-ecosophy
tokens.usage: Ecosophy proper: Næss, Guattari, Morizot. Same as moss: the project's own branch. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-deep-ecology
tokens.usage: Deep ecology and environmental ethics (fir): Leopold, Rolston, Devall, Sessions. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-social-ecology
tokens.usage: Social ecology and municipalism (rust): Bookchin, Biehl. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-ecosocialism
tokens.usage: Ecosocialism and eco-Marxism (madder): Foster, Löwy, Malm, Saito. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-degrowth
tokens.usage: Degrowth and bioeconomics (ochre): Georgescu-Roegen, Latouche, Kallis, Hickel. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-ecofeminism
tokens.usage: Ecofeminism (heather): d'Eaubonne, Merchant, Plumwood, Mies, Shiva. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-political-ecology
tokens.usage: Political ecology as a discipline (slate): Martinez-Alier, Escobar, Robbins, Descola. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-decolonial
tokens.usage: Decolonial ecology and environmental justice (indigo, the plantation dye): Ferdinand, Guha, Bullard. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-anthropocene
tokens.usage: Anthropocene, Gaia and new materialisms (lagoon): Latour, Stengers, Haraway, Tsing. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-technocritique
tokens.usage: Technocritique and eco-anarchism (olive): Ellul, Charbonneau, Illich, Gorz. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-queer-ecology
tokens.usage: Queer ecology (orchid): Mortimer-Sandilands, Erickson, Seymour. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-democracy
tokens.usage: Ecological democracy and green populism (violet): Laclau, Mouffe, Dryzek, Dobson, Bourg. As text or a 3px stroke; always with the branch name or emblem.

tokens.name: branch-collapse
tokens.usage: Collapse and transition (sienna): Bardi, Tainter, Diamond, Heinberg, Hopkins, Bendell, Cochet. As text or a 3px stroke; always with the branch name or emblem.

tokens.name: branch-counterpoint
tokens.usage: Counterpoints grafted onto the tree (basalt): ecomodernism, green growth. Shown for debate, never as a branch of the field. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or glyph.

tokens.name: branch-market
tokens.usage: Market liberals grafted onto the tree (pewter): Pigou, Coase, Nordhaus, Lomborg, Ferry. Shown for debate, never as a branch of the field. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or emblem.

tokens.name: branch-conservative
tokens.usage: Conservatives grafted onto the tree (umber): Scruton, Goldsmith, Laudato si', de Benoist. Shown for debate, never as a branch of the field. As text or a 3px stroke, on paper and paper-raised; always with the branch name or emblem.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces from Google Fonts: names, titles and quotes. Soft, organic serif with an optical-size axis.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero and video title cards only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Author and school page titles; capsule name card.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Sourced verbatim quotes only, under 25 words, always with a citation.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans from Google Fonts: interface and reading text.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Who read whom, and what they disagreed on.
styles.usage: First paragraph of an author or school page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ecology without social critique is gardening.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Cited in 214 works on this map.
styles.usage: Card text, legends, captions and source lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Branch chips, view tabs, the Sourced and Simulated marks. Uppercase.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts: dates, references, identifiers.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Lifespans, years, Wikidata QIDs, page references, run ids.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between metadata lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a card.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing; video safe margin at 1080p.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tooltips, small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and panels.

tokens.name: radius-leaf
tokens.usage: The leaf cut: apply to the top-right and bottom-left corners only (border-radius: 0 24px 0 24px). Author leaves and the capsule name card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Branch chips and seed (concept) tags.

stroke.note: Line weights for the graph, timeline and glyphs.

tokens.name: stroke-thread
tokens.usage: Mycelium links and the Simulated dashed outline.

tokens.name: stroke-branch
tokens.usage: Branch lines in the Tree view, stance bars.

tokens.name: stroke-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph strokes at 24px.

tokens.name: stroke-ground
tokens.usage: The ground line: one full-width ink rule per page, between what is visible and what feeds it.
